name: Reverse Iron Butterfly
summary: Buy an ATM straddle and sell equidistant OTM wings for a debit; a defined-risk, three-strike long-vol trade that pays if the underlying leaves the range.

legs.strike_rule: same body strike as the long put

typical_dte: 1-21 DTE, opened 1-3 sessions before a catalyst
when_to_use: IV rank < 25, a dated catalyst inside the expiry, and a compressed range (ATR(14) in the bottom quartile of the last 100 sessions). Cheaper than a plain long straddle because the sold wings finance it, at the cost of capping the payoff.
max_profit: (wing width x 100) - net debit, reached when spot is at or beyond either wing
max_loss: net debit paid, at the body strike. Defined.
entry_rules: Net debit <= 70% of wing width; target <= 60% so the structure pays at least 0.6:1.
A dated catalyst must land inside the expiry.
Both long legs must share the identical ATM strike; wings equidistant.
OI >= 500 and per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid) on all four contracts.
Single 4-leg limit order at mid, pay up to mid + $0.03.
Risk (the debit) <= 1% of equity per position.
management_rules: Close at 50% of max profit, i.e. when mark >= debit + 0.5*(width - debit).
Close the session after the catalyst resolves, win or lose - post-event theta and vol crush are brutal.
Stop: close if mark <= 50% of the debit paid.
Do not roll; take the loss and re-evaluate.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: the two sold wings can be assigned once ITM. Flatten the whole structure by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if either short wing is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10 - this is exactly the winning scenario, so the guard fires on winners, not losers.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before the ex-date if the short call wing is ITM with extrinsic below the dividend.
assignment_risk: Ironically, assignment risk peaks when the trade is winning: the short wing on the side the underlying ran to goes deep ITM and loses extrinsic. Assignment there delivers shares (short 100 on the call wing, long 100 on the put wing) offset only by the long ATM option. Close the winner rather than let it ride to expiry.
buying_power: Net debit paid only; the long ATM legs cover the short wings.
common_mistakes: Buying it in high IV (you are buying the ATM straddle - the most vol-sensitive part of the chain); holding after the catalyst; letting a deep-ITM short wing sit unclosed; paying more than 70% of width and having almost no payoff left.
zero_dte_notes: Workable as a 0DTE breakout play around 09:35-09:50 ET or immediately ahead of an 08:30/10:00 ET data print, with wings at 0.5-0.8% and a debit under 50% of width. Decays to zero fast - hold minutes, not hours. Flatten by 15:45 ET, and close any deep-ITM short wing the moment its extrinsic drops under $0.10.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
also_filed_under: four-leg structures (iron condors, iron butterflies, condors, double calendars/diagonals, boxes, jelly rolls, conversions/reversals, double verticals, double ratio spreads)
